text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 at 25W. Two are clearly buyable in the US right now.

**Available in the US**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)** is Qi2.2 certified, with 25W wireless charging and 45W wired output over USB-C. It recharges at up to 30W. It launched in the US and Europe and costs $79.99 on Amazon or $59.99 on Baseus's site ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). Dealectric reports code AM52 took $6 off in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-24, making it $53.99 ([listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. The store's checkout has the final word on price.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10K, active cooling fan)** has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, 45W USB-C recharging and a built-in display and stand. It costs $109.99, but it's a pre-order that ships Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026 ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)).

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm US purchase details**

- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank** was the first power bank with Qi2.2 certification from the Wireless Power Consortium, with 25W charging. UGREEN's press release said it would launch in Q3 2025 on Amazon and UGREEN's site ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). The results gave no current price or product page.
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank** is an ultra-thin Qi2 25W model previewed at CES 2026 ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)). The results gave no release date or price.

**Japan only**

- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K** has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging and a built-in 35W USB-C cable. It's sold in Japan for ¥8,980 ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)), and I saw no US availability.

**Compatibility:** 25W needs a phone that supports Qi2.2. For the Baseus, that means iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e) on iOS 26. iPhone 12–15 get 15W. Notebookcheck also lists the Google Pixel 10 Pro XL as compatible.

If you tell me your phone and budget, I can narrow it down. The Baseus is the cheaper option, while the Anker adds active cooling but costs more and ships later.
